context: A couple sorts out a contractor agreement at the kitchen table
purpose: Teach: 承諾/着用/期日/着目/配列/精密/随時/皆無

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 業者から契約書が届いたよ。期日は今月末だって。
lines.en: The contract arrived from the contractor. The deadline is the end of this month.
lines.style: Calm father tone, slightly tired after work, businesslike but warm with wife.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ちょっと見せて。まず料金の項目に着目したいの。
lines.en: Let me see it. I want to focus on the pricing section first.
lines.style: Practical mother voice, focused and analytical, takes charge of household paperwork confidently.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 数字の配列がややこしくてさ、何度読んでも頭に入らない。
lines.en: The arrangement of numbers is confusing. I can't take it in no matter how often I read.
lines.style: Slightly frustrated husband, scratching head, leaning back at the kitchen table.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ここ、精密機械の搬入条件まで書いてあるわよ。作業中はヘルメット着用必須ですって。
lines.en: Look, it even covers conditions for bringing in precision equipment. Helmets are required during work.
lines.style: Reading carefully aloud, slightly surprised tone, pointing at small print with finger.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: 細かいなあ。質問は随時受け付けますって書いてあるから、不明点はメールしよう。
lines.en: So detailed. It says questions are accepted anytime, so let's email anything unclear.
lines.style: Relieved husband, nodding, finding one helpful clause in dense document.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 正直、この業者についての悪い評判は皆無だったから、私は信用してるんだけど。
lines.en: Honestly, there were zero bad reviews about this contractor, so I trust them.
lines.style: Reassuring wife, confident in her own research, looking up from the paperwork.

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: じゃあ最後のページに承諾のサインして、明日の朝にでも投函しようか。
lines.en: Then I'll sign the consent on the last page, and we can mail it tomorrow morning.
lines.style: Decisive husband ready to wrap up, pen already in hand, looking for closure.
